title: symphyotrichum elliottii
intro: Symphyotrichum elliottii, commonly known as Elliott's or coastal aster, is a flowering plant species within the aster family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of Symphyotrichum elliottii include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
